topic_name_ja: 開発環境・アーキテクチャ・ライフサイクル管理 (LCS & Dev Tools)
title: Topic 1 Question #3
question_en:
HOTSPOT -
You are a Dynamics 365 Finance developer.
You need to monitor system performance.
Which tools should you use? To answer, select the appropriate option in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
question_ja:
ホットスポット -
あなたは Dynamics 365 Finance 開発者です。
システムのパフォーマンスを監視する必要があります。
どのツールを使用する必要がありますか?回答するには、回答領域で適切なオプションを選択してください。
注: 正しく選択するたびに 1 ポイントの価値があります。
dump_answer: Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler
community_answer: Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler

ai_verdict.correct_answer: Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler
ai_verdict.dump_answer: Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler
ai_verdict.badge_en: AI Verified: LCS + Trace Parser + SQL Profiler
ai_verdict.badge_ja: AI公式判定: LCS + トレースパーサー + SQLプロファイラー
ai_verdict.concept_en: Performance Diagnostics Tool Selection (LCS, Trace Parser, SQL Profiler, Fiddler)
ai_verdict.concept_ja: パフォーマンス診断ツールの選定 (LCS, Trace Parser, SQL Profiler, Fiddler)
ai_verdict.analysis_en: Microsoft Dynamics Trace Parser is designed to consume traces and isolate long-running X++ methods, heavy SQL queries, and RPC client-server calls.
ai_verdict.analysis_ja: Microsoft Dynamics トレース パーサー (Trace Parser) は、収集したトレースログを解析し、時間のかかる X++ メソッド呼び出し、SQL クエリ、およびクライアント/サーバー通信のボトルネックを特定するために設計されています。
ai_verdict.strategy_ja: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations におけるパフォーマンス問題の診断では、監視スコープ（システム全体 vs 特定フォーム vs 単一プロセス/SQL）およびクラウド環境層（クラウド全体 vs クライアント/ネットワーク vs AOS/DB）に応じたツールの適切な使い分けが問われます。
ai_verdict.strategy_en: Performance troubleshooting in Dynamics 365 F&O requires choosing the right tool based on the scope (system-wide health vs form latency vs single process SQL statements) and architectural tier (Cloud telemetry vs Client/HTTP vs AOS/Database).

box_breakdowns.requirement_ja: システムの全体的な稼働状態、現在実行中のプロセス、および履歴データを確認する
box_breakdowns.requirement_en: Review overall health of the system, as well as currently running processes and historical data
box_breakdowns.why_ja: Lifecycle Services (LCS) の環境監視ツール (Environment Monitoring) は、クラウド上の AOS、バッチサーバー、SQL データベースの稼働状況や、現在アクティブなユーザーセッション、システム全体の CPU/メモリ消費量、過去の履歴テレメトリを一元的にダッシュボード表示できる唯一の公式ツールです。
box_breakdowns.why_en: The LCS Environment Monitoring tool is the dedicated cloud dashboard for monitoring overall environment health, active user sessions, batch executions, and historical metric telemetry.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: Fiddler や Trace Parser はローカルまたは特定クライアントセッションのトレースのみをキャプチャするため、システム全体の稼働監視や履歴データの参照は不可能です。

box_breakdowns.requirement_ja: さまざまなフォームの読み込み時間と待機時間 (レイテンシ) を確認する
box_breakdowns.requirement_en: Review the load time and latency of different forms
box_breakdowns.why_ja: トレース パーサー (Trace Parser) は、ETW トレースログを解析してフォームの初期化（init, run）、データソースのクエリ実行、X++ メソッドごとの消費時間、および RPC クライアント/サーバー間通信のレイテンシをタイムライン形式で可視化します。マイクロソフト公式ドキュメントでもフォームのパフォーマンス解析ツールの本命として指定されています。
box_breakdowns.why_en: Trace Parser consumes ETW traces to profile form initialization, control rendering, X++ method execution call trees, and RPC round-trips, making it the definitive tool for diagnosing form load time and latency.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: 【コミュニティ最多の誤答陷阱：Fiddler】Fiddler はブラウザとサーバー間の生の HTTP 通信しかキャプチャできません。フォーム内部のコントロール描画時間や X++ のメソッド処理時間は Fiddler では一切判別できないため不適切です。

box_breakdowns.requirement_ja: 単一のプロセスを確認し、実行されているコードと SQL ステートメントを確認する
box_breakdowns.requirement_en: Review a single process and see the code and SQL statements that are being run
box_breakdowns.why_ja: 開発/テスト環境 (Tier-1) において、特定のユーザーセッションまたは単一プロセスが発行している生の T-SQL クエリやストアドプロシージャをリアルタイムで追跡・キャプチャするには SQL Server Profiler を使用します。
box_breakdowns.why_en: SQL Server Profiler captures exact T-SQL queries and stored procedure statements generated by the AOS for a specific process or SPID in development/test environments.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: LCS 環境監視ツールは集計クエリや上位高負荷クエリの統計を表示するものであり、単一プロセスの詳細な SQL ステートメントのリアルタイムトレースには適していません。

ai_verdict.trap_clarification_ja: ExamTopics 社区常见争议：很多考生在 Box 2 误选 Fiddler，在 Box 3 误选 Trace Parser。关键考点口诀：【环境宏观全局看 LCS】、【表单内部加载看 Trace Parser】、【网络 HTTP 抓包看 Fiddler】、【底层 SQL 语句执行看 SQL Profiler】。
ai_verdict.trap_clarification_en: Key Exam Rule: 1. System-wide & historical telemetry -> LCS Monitoring; 2. Form load time & X++ execution -> Trace Parser; 3. Network HTTP requests -> Fiddler; 4. Detailed T-SQL statements -> SQL Profiler.
ai_verdict.verification_verdict_ja: ✓ AI 终审核验通过：经核对微软官方技术文档与考纲逻辑，AI 推理与官方标准正解【Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler】完全吻合。
ai_verdict.verification_verdict_en: ✓ AI Final Verification: Fully aligns with official Microsoft Learn technical documentation and standard solution [Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool | Box 2: Trace Parser | Box 3: SQL Profiler].

Box 1: LCS Environment Monitoring tool
Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services (LCS) provides to help you monitor, diagnose, and analyze the health of the Finance and Operations

box_breakdowns.requirement_en: Users need to see updated information in an object that can be pinned on their workspace
box_breakdowns.why_ja: タイル (Tile) は、未処理伝票件数や最新ステータスなどの集計値を動的に表示し、ワークスペースに固定 (Pin) してクイックナビゲーションを提供する標準オブジェクトです。
box_breakdowns.why_en: Tiles are summary objects displaying live counts and metrics that can be pinned to workspace sections for direct navigation.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: Dashboard や Enumeration はワークスペース内の個別ピン留め集計オブジェクトとしては機能しません。

box_breakdowns.requirement_ja: ユーザーのセキュリティ ロールに基づいた既定のホームページ

box_breakdowns.why_en: The role-tailored default landing homepage in Dynamics 365 F&O is the default Dashboard.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: Tile や Embedded BI はホームページそのものではなく、ホームページやワークスペース内に配置されるコンポーネントです。

box_breakdowns.why_en: Self-service BI empowers business analysts to author, edit, and modify analytics directly within the application.
box_breakdowns.why_not_ja: Embedded BI は開発者が事前に埋め込んだ固定レポートであり、エンドユーザーが自由に新規分析を作成するものではありません。

question_en:
Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm produces and sells jarred food goods. The organization has several production and warehouse locations
across the United States. Each location runs both production and warehousing operations. The company has three locations: East, Central, and
West.
The company is upgrading its Dynamics AX 2009 system to Dynamics 365 Finance.
Current environment. General -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to migrate customizations, data, and integration from its legacy system into Dynamics 365 finance
and operations apps.
The Dynamics 365 finance and operations environment includes:
• multiple cloud-hosted development environments using Microsoft Visual Studio 2017
• a Microsoft Azure DevOps project for source control
• two tier 2 environments for user acceptance testing and staging, as well as production
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the planning and development phase of the upgrade process. The company's internal
development team needs additional development resources to address issues. The company already created a project that is set up to use a
custom model named GPExtensions.
Current environment. Integrations
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has a new integration for its freight processing information. The internal development team created the
secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) site for the source information to be stored and the staging table to house the source information once the
data is added to Dynamics 365 Finance. Information from the source will be transferred once a day from the source system and integrated with
the target system. More than 10,000 records will be transferred over the integration. The company created an aggregate entity for the integration
to minimize the amount of transmitted data.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has added a new integration for freight processing where all item weights, dimensions, and other factors
will be configured in the external portal while planning the loads. Once the load is planned, it will be integrated into Dynamics 365 finance and
operations apps for the freight invoice processing to occur.
No duplicate invoices or posting are associated with the freight invoice charges. The integration of this information from the source system is
intended only for report creation and compilation purposes.
Current environment. Planned changes
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change inventory forms to fit its current needs. Any modifications or enhancements must follow
the existing functionality for forms in Dynamics 365 Finance.
Requirements. Integrations -
All data from integrations have the same format as an existing Dynamics 365 Finance apps field. All enhancements or customizations must use
existing assets before creating new functionality.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change its integration strategy to include real-time data from the freight processing source
system. The inventory must update as it is sold from the system. That information will be updated in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The freight processing integration requires the use of an SFTP site to store XML files from the source system. The additional integration will use
OData and must be transferred in real time.
A periodic batch job must:
• Pull data from the SFTP site.
• Import the data to a staging table used to hold the information from the source system.
• Map source data to the target table in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The imported Load ID field must be added to the Sales Order header for all processed orders. Additional requirements for integrations, including
other integration strategies, may be necessary as the company grows. Existing tables must be changed to include the Load ID. The database will
need to be synched before adding the Load ID field.
Requirements. Changes -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm must change the Inventory Status form to include more columns. It plans to create a table to enter the data
for the Inventory Status form as a new data source. The company wants to add both the Product Name field and Batch ID field to this new table.
The current form includes the item number, location, license plate, product inventory dimensions, and quantity.
The grid on the Inventory Status form must include the product name by using the item number and legal entity. The user interface must be
created to include the new columns and the data must be available to add to the grid. The form must have only an Action Pane, a Navigation List,
a List Style Grid, a Details Header, and a Details Tab in the design and include the Load ID field.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the process of adding the other required fields: one for Product Name and one for Batch ID.
The new fields must be related to extended data types for the original fields on the existing data source for the Inventory Status form. Munson's
Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to add the EcoResProductName and Batch ID data to the extended table for WHSTmpStatusChange. The fields
on the table extension must be populated with data and visible on the Inventory Status form on insert.
Issues -
• The internal development team has created the SFTP site connections, the staging table, and the batch jobs for the new integration for freight
processing. The development team needs to map the source data to the target table and the data management workspace. The development team
notices errors with mapping target fields in the data management workspace. The team needs another developer to configure the table
extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
• The internal development team has issues adding the required fields to the Inventory Status standard form. The team needs another developer to
configure the table extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
You need to apply a pattern to the newly created form to satisfy the requirements.
Which form pattern should you apply?
question_ja:

これはケーススタディです。ケーススタディは個別に時間が設定されるわけではありません。各ケースを完了したいだけ試験時間を費やすことができます。ただし、

背景 -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、瓶詰め食品を製造および販売しています。組織には複数の生産拠点と倉庫拠点があります

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、カスタマイズ、データ、統合を従来のシステムから Dynamics 365 Finance に移行することを計画しています
および操作アプリ。
Dynamics 365 の財務および運用環境には次のものが含まれます。

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は現在、アップグレード プロセスの計画と開発段階にあります。会社の内部
開発チームは問題に対処するために追加の開発リソースを必要としています。会社はすでに、
GPExtensions という名前のカスタム モデル。

ターゲットシステム。この統合により、10,000 件を超えるレコードが転送されます。同社は統合のために集合体を作成した

処理中。開発チームは、ソース データをターゲット テーブルおよびデータ管理ワークスペースにマップする必要があります。開発チーム
データ管理ワークスペース内のターゲット フィールドのマッピングに関するエラーを通知します。チームにはテーブルを構成するために別の開発者が必要です

question_en:
HOTSPOT
-
Case study
-
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study
-
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background
-
ADatum Corporation is a market leader in the design and distribution of innovative aluminum systems. The company provides services to the
architectural, residential, industrial, and home improvement markets in Australia.
The company has warehouses in Perth. Sydney, and Melbourne. A team of warehouse employees provides delivery to the customer sites.
Current Environment
-
ADatum Corporation currently uses Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009.
Customers use email or phone calls to place orders. After the company provides a quote to customers, the customer must agree to the sale price
before the company places a sales order.
The company is migrating to Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management using a phased rollout strategy to its sites. The
company has the Lifecycle services project to manage various environments and releases.
The company has the following Finance and Supply Chain Management environments:
• Development
• Quality assurance (QA)
• User acceptance testing (UAT)
• Production
The company uses Azure DevOps for a code repository. All developers use a development branch to check in code and a release branch to
maintain the code for production releases.
Requirements. General
-
• Configure a cloud-based development environment for Finance and Supply Chain Management. Enable a code extension that supports updates.
• Configure Microsoft-supported version control and an Azure-hosted build pipeline.
• Migrate all document handling attachments for the customers to Finance and Supply Chain Management from Dynamics AX 2009.
• Audit X++ code for a best practice check.
• All new code must be unit tested in a development environment and then validated by the QA team before the code is merged into the Release
branch for further releases.
Requirements. Business processes
• All changes that are deployed to the UAT environment must be approved for code release to production.
• The sales manager requires a solution that is extensible to ensure that new master tables document handling attachments are migrated to the
new system.
• A base class named MigrateAttachment must be designed with methods that all child classes must implement.
• A method named processAttachment must be created so that extenders are not able to subscribe to pre-events and post-events.
• On the All sales orders list page, two new fields must be added for the total sales order amount. One field uses goods and services tax (GST) and
the other field does not use GST.
• A process named Populate check data must be designed based on the following:
o The process must run from the All customers list page and populate a custom table named CustCheckData with 1000 rows.
o The table must have two fields named CheckNumber and BankNumber.
o The process must return to the current session after the data is processed.
• The generated check data must be available for users to access in a tabular form without additional details and preview panes.
• The purchase manager requires a new data entity to send out the information for purchase order inquiries that are generated in Finance and
Supply Chain Management
• The sales manager must be able to access the total quotation for the sites and item types.
• The sales manager requires a quotation number to be printed on the sales invoice business document. Customers must be able to access the
reference number on the invoice documents.
• The purchase manager requires a new approval workflow for approving purchase orders that are more than $10,000.
Requirements. Business systems
-
• After a user named UserA posts a packing slip for a sales order, customers must be informed of the product delivery in real-time. This
information is provided using business events.
• Purchase order inquiries must be exported from the Finance and Supply Chain Management using data packages. Users must be able to query
using OData but should not be able to update or create the data in the system.
• A sales manager’s workspace must display the total quotations using key performance indicators.
• The purchase order approval workflow must be configured from the procurement and sourcing module.
Issues
-
• UserA reports delays when opening the All sales orders list page.
• A customer is unable to access the business events for a packing slip that is posted by UserA.
• A user named UserB reports that the system is unresponsive when they run the Populate check data process for a customer.
• UserA reports that the print management settings in the accounts receivable module do not display the new layout when testing a new sales
invoice report layout in the UAT environment.
You need to create the new approval workflow for purchase orders.
What should you use? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
question_ja:
ホットスポット
-
ケーススタディ
-
これはケーススタディです。ケーススタディは個別に時間が設定されるわけではありません。各ケースを完了したいだけ試験時間を費やすことができます。ただし、
この試験には追加のケーススタディやセクションがある場合があります。すべての質問に確実に回答できるように時間を管理する必要があります
指定された時間内でこの試験に含まれています。
ケーススタディに含まれる質問に答えるには、ケーススタディで提供される情報を参照する必要があります。ケーススタディでは、
ケーススタディで説明されているシナリオに関する詳細情報を提供する展示やその他のリソースが含まれています。それぞれの質問は、
このケーススタディの他の質問とは独立しています。
このケーススタディの最後に、レビュー画面が表示されます。この画面では、回答を確認し、次のステップに進む前に変更を加えることができます。
試験の次のセクション。新しいセクションを開始した後は、このセクションに戻ることはできません。

question_en:
Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
ADatum Corporation is a market leader in the design and distribution of innovative aluminum systems. The company provides services to the
architectural, residential, industrial, and home improvement markets in Australia.
The company has warehouses in Perth. Sydney, and Melbourne. A team of warehouse employees provides delivery to the customer sites.
Current Environment -
ADatum Corporation currently uses Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009.
Customers use email or phone calls to place orders. After the company provides a quote to customers, the customer must agree to the sale price
before the company places a sales order.
The company is migrating to Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management using a phased rollout strategy to its sites. The
company has the Lifecycle services project to manage various environments and releases.
The company has the following Finance and Supply Chain Management environments:
• Development
• Quality assurance (QA)
• User acceptance testing (UAT)
• Production
The company uses Azure DevOps for a code repository. All developers use a development branch to check in code and a release branch to
maintain the code for production releases.
Requirements. General -
• Configure a cloud-based development environment for Finance and Supply Chain Management. Enable a code extension that supports updates.
• Configure Microsoft-supported version control and an Azure-hosted build pipeline.
• Migrate all document handling attachments for the customers to Finance and Supply Chain Management from Dynamics AX 2009.
• Audit X++ code for a best practice check.
• All new code must be unit tested in a development environment and then validated by the QA team before the code is merged into the Release
branch for further releases.
Requirements. Business processes
• All changes that are deployed to the UAT environment must be approved for code release to production.
• The sales manager requires a solution that is extensible to ensure that new master tables document handling attachments are migrated to the
new system.
• A base class named MigrateAttachment must be designed with methods that all child classes must implement.
• A method named processAttachment must be created so that extenders are not able to subscribe to pre-events and post-events.
• On the All sales orders list page, two new fields must be added for the total sales order amount. One field uses goods and services tax (GST) and
the other field does not use GST.
• A process named Populate check data must be designed based on the following: o The process must run from the All customers list page and
populate a custom table named CustCheckData with 1000 rows. o The table must have two fields named CheckNumber and BankNumber. o The
process must return to the current session after the data is processed.
• The generated check data must be available for users to access in a tabular form without additional details and preview panes.
• The purchase manager requires a new data entity to send out the information for purchase order inquiries that are generated in Finance and
Supply Chain Management
• The sales manager must be able to access the total quotation for the sites and item types.
• The sales manager requires a quotation number to be printed on the sales invoice business document. Customers must be able to access the
reference number on the invoice documents.
• The purchase manager requires a new approval workflow for approving purchase orders that are more than $10,000.
Requirements. Business systems -
• After a user named UserA posts a packing slip for a sales order, customers must be informed of the product delivery in real-time. This
information is provided using business events.
• Purchase order inquiries must be exported from the Finance and Supply Chain Management using data packages. Users must be able to query
using OData but should not be able to update or create the data in the system.
• A sales manager’s workspace must display the total quotations using key performance indicators.
• The purchase order approval workflow must be configured from the procurement and sourcing module.
Issues -
• UserA reports delays when opening the All sales orders list page.
• A customer is unable to access the business events for a packing slip that is posted by UserA.
• A user named UserB reports that the system is unresponsive when they run the Populate check data process for a customer.
• UserA reports that the print management settings in the accounts receivable module do not display the new layout when testing a new sales
invoice report layout in the UAT environment.
You need to design a form to display the check data.
Which two form patterns can you use? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

title: Topic 2 Question #16
question_en:
DRAG DROP
-
Case study
-
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study
-
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background
-
ADatum Corporation is a market leader in the design and distribution of innovative aluminum systems. The company provides services to the
architectural, residential, industrial, and home improvement markets in Australia.
The company has warehouses in Perth. Sydney, and Melbourne. A team of warehouse employees provides delivery to the customer sites.
Current Environment
-
ADatum Corporation currently uses Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009.
Customers use email or phone calls to place orders. After the company provides a quote to customers, the customer must agree to the sale price
before the company places a sales order.
The company is migrating to Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management using a phased rollout strategy to its sites. The
company has the Lifecycle services project to manage various environments and releases.
The company has the following Finance and Supply Chain Management environments:
• Development
• Quality assurance (QA)
• User acceptance testing (UAT)
• Production
The company uses Azure DevOps for a code repository. All developers use a development branch to check in code and a release branch to
maintain the code for production releases.
Requirements. General
-
• Configure a cloud-based development environment for Finance and Supply Chain Management. Enable a code extension that supports updates.
• Configure Microsoft-supported version control and an Azure-hosted build pipeline.
• Migrate all document handling attachments for the customers to Finance and Supply Chain Management from Dynamics AX 2009.
• Audit X++ code for a best practice check.
• All new code must be unit tested in a development environment and then validated by the QA team before the code is merged into the Release
branch for further releases.
Requirements. Business processes
• All changes that are deployed to the UAT environment must be approved for code release to production.
• The sales manager requires a solution that is extensible to ensure that new master tables document handling attachments are migrated to the
new system.
• A base class named MigrateAttachment must be designed with methods that all child classes must implement.
• A method named processAttachment must be created so that extenders are not able to subscribe to pre-events and post-events.
• On the All sales orders list page, two new fields must be added for the total sales order amount. One field uses goods and services tax (GST) and
the other field does not use GST.
• A process named Populate check data must be designed based on the following:
o The process must run from the All customers list page and populate a custom table named CustCheckData with 1000 rows.
o The table must have two fields named CheckNumber and BankNumber.
o The process must return to the current session after the data is processed.
• The generated check data must be available for users to access in a tabular form without additional details and preview panes.
• The purchase manager requires a new data entity to send out the information for purchase order inquiries that are generated in Finance and
Supply Chain Management
• The sales manager must be able to access the total quotation for the sites and item types.
• The sales manager requires a quotation number to be printed on the sales invoice business document. Customers must be able to access the
reference number on the invoice documents.
• The purchase manager requires a new approval workflow for approving purchase orders that are more than $10,000.
Requirements. Business systems
-
• After a user named UserA posts a packing slip for a sales order, customers must be informed of the product delivery in real-time. This
information is provided using business events.
• Purchase order inquiries must be exported from the Finance and Supply Chain Management using data packages. Users must be able to query
using OData but should not be able to update or create the data in the system.
• A sales manager’s workspace must display the total quotations using key performance indicators.
• The purchase order approval workflow must be configured from the procurement and sourcing module.
Issues
-
• UserA reports delays when opening the All sales orders list page.
• A customer is unable to access the business events for a packing slip that is posted by UserA.
• A user named UserB reports that the system is unresponsive when they run the Populate check data process for a customer.
• UserA reports that the print management settings in the accounts receivable module do not display the new layout when testing a new sales
invoice report layout in the UAT environment.
You must merge the code change that you performed and which was tested by QA to the production environment.
You need to merge a specific changeset.
Which three actions should you perform in sequence? To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and
arrange them in the correct order.
question_ja:
DRAG DROP
-
ケーススタディ
-
これはケーススタディです。ケーススタディは個別に時間が設定されるわけではありません。各ケースを完了したいだけ試験時間を費やすことができます。ただし、
この試験には追加のケーススタディやセクションがある場合があります。すべての質問に確実に回答できるように時間を管理する必要があります
指定された時間内でこの試験に含まれています。
ケーススタディに含まれる質問に答えるには、ケーススタディで提供される情報を参照する必要があります。ケーススタディでは、
ケーススタディで説明されているシナリオに関する詳細情報を提供する展示やその他のリソースが含まれています。それぞれの質問は、
このケーススタディの他の質問とは独立しています。
このケーススタディの最後に、レビュー画面が表示されます。この画面では、回答を確認し、次のステップに進む前に変更を加えることができます。
試験の次のセクション。新しいセクションを開始した後は、このセクションに戻ることはできません。
ケーススタディを開始するには
-
このケーススタディの最初の質問を表示するには、「次へ」ボタンをクリックします。左側のペインのボタンを使用して、ケーススタディの内容を調べます。
質問に答える前に。これらのボタンをクリックすると、ビジネス要件、既存の環境、問題などの情報が表示されます。
発言。質問に答える準備ができたら、「質問」ボタンをクリックして質問に戻ります。
背景
-
ADatum Corporation は、革新的なアルミニウム システムの設計と販売における市場リーダーです。同社は次のようなサービスを提供しています。
オーストラリアの建築、住宅、工業、住宅改善市場。
その会社はパースに倉庫を持っています。シドニーとメルボルン。倉庫従業員のチームが顧客サイトへの配送を行います。
現在の環境
-
ADatum Corporation は現在、Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009 を使用しています。
顧客は電子メールまたは電話を使用して注文します。当社が顧客に見積もりを提示した後、顧客は販売価格に同意する必要があります
会社が販売注文を出す前に。
同社は、サイトへの段階的なロールアウト戦略を使用して、Dynamics 365 Finance と Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management に移行しています。の
同社には、さまざまな環境とリリースを管理するためのライフサイクル サービス プロジェクトがあります。
同社には次の財務およびサプライ チェーン管理環境があります。
• 開発
• 品質保証 (QA)
• ユーザー受け入れテスト (UAT)
• 生産
同社はコード リポジトリに Azure DevOps を使用しています。すべての開発者は開発ブランチを使用してコードをチェックインし、リリース ブランチを使用してコードをチェックインします。
実稼働リリース用のコードを保守します。
要件。一般
-
• 財務およびサプライ チェーン管理用のクラウドベースの開発環境を構成します。更新をサポートするコード拡張機能を有効にします。
• Microsoft がサポートするバージョン管理と Azure がホストするビルド パイプラインを構成します。
• 顧客向けのすべてのドキュメント処理添付ファイルを Dynamics AX 2009 から Finance and Supply Chain Management に移行します。
• ベスト プラクティス チェックのために X++ コードを監査します。
• 新しいコードはすべて、開発環境で単体テストを行った後、コードがリリースにマージされる前に QA チームによって検証される必要があります。
さらなるリリースについてはブランチを参照してください。
要件。ビジネスプロセス
• UAT 環境に展開されるすべての変更は、運用環境へのコード リリースの承認を受ける必要があります。
• 営業マネージャーは、新しいマスター テーブルのドキュメント処理添付ファイルが確実にマスター テーブルに移行されるように拡張可能なソリューションを必要としています。
新しいシステム。
• MigrateAttachment という名前の基本クラスは、すべての子クラスが実装する必要があるメソッドを使用して設計する必要があります。
• エクステンダーが事前イベントおよび事後イベントをサブスクライブできないように、processAttachment という名前のメソッドを作成する必要があります。
• [すべての販売注文] リスト ページで、合計販売注文金額を表す 2 つの新しいフィールドを追加する必要があります。 1 つのフィールドでは物品サービス税 (GST) が使用され、
他のフィールドでは GST は使用されません。
• Populate check data という名前のプロセスは、以下に基づいて設計する必要があります。
o プロセスは [すべての顧客] リスト ページから実行し、CustCheckData という名前のカスタム テーブルに 1000 行を追加する必要があります。
o テーブルには、CheckNumber と BankNumber という名前の 2 つのフィールドが必要です。
o データが処理された後、プロセスは現在のセッションに戻る必要があります。
• 生成されたチェック データは、追加の詳細やプレビュー ペインなしで表形式でユーザーがアクセスできる必要があります。
• 購買マネージャーは、財務部門で生成された発注書照会の情報を送信するために、新しいデータ エンティティを必要とします。
サプライチェーン管理
• 営業マネージャーは、サイトおよびアイテム タイプの合計見積額にアクセスできる必要があります。
• 営業マネージャーは、見積書番号を売上請求書のビジネス文書に印刷することを要求します。顧客はアクセスできる必要があります。
請求書書類の参照番号。
• 購買マネージャーは、10,000 ドルを超える発注書を承認するための新しい承認ワークフローを必要とします。
要件。業務システム
-
• UserA という名前のユーザーが販売注文の梱包明細を投稿した後、顧客は製品の配達についてリアルタイムで通知される必要があります。これ
ビジネスイベントを利用して情報が提供されます。
• 発注書の照会は、データ パッケージを使用して財務およびサプライ チェーン管理からエクスポートする必要があります。ユーザーはクエリを実行できる必要があります
OData を使用しますが、システム内のデータを更新または作成することはできません。
• 営業マネージャーのワークスペースには、主要業績評価指標を使用して見積総額を表示する必要があります。
• 発注書の承認ワークフローは、調達および調達モジュールから設定する必要があります。
問題点

question_en:
HOTSPOT -
A company is implementing Dynamics 365 Finance. Vendors receive a risk rating that is determined by their on-time delivery performance as well
as their credit rating.
You need to implement the following risk rating functionality:
✑ The risk rating must accompany the credit rating when the credit rating is used.
✑ The risk rating must be able to be used in other areas of the solution to determine processing outcomes.
✑ The risk rating must consist of the following values:
1 = Good
2 = Medium
3 = Risky
The risk rating must be displayed in the Miscellaneous Details tab below the Credit Rating and Credit Limit fields in the Vendor form.
What should you do? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
question_ja:
ホットスポット -
ある企業は Dynamics 365 Finance を導入しています。ベンダーは、納期厳守の実績によっても決定されるリスク評価を受け取ります。
彼らの信用格付けとして。

✑ 信用格付けを使用する場合、リスク格付けを信用格付けに付随させる必要があります。
✑ リスク評価は、処理の結果を決定するためにソリューションの他の領域で使用できなければなりません。
✑ リスク評価は次の値で構成されている必要があります。
1 = 良い
2 = 中
3 = 危険
リスク評価は、ベンダー フォームの信用評価および信用限度フィールドの下にあるその他の詳細タブに表示する必要があります。
どうすればいいでしょうか？回答するには、回答領域で適切なオプションを選択してください。

the CoC, the expectation is that they will only conditionally break it. The compiler doesn't enforce calls to next.
To be replaceable, a method must also be wrappable.

You create a new interface class in Dynamics 365 Finance. The class has two methods.
You need to create a valid interface class.
Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
question_ja:
Dynamics 365 Finance で新しいインターフェイス クラスを作成します。このクラスには 2 つのメソッドがあります。
有効なインターフェイス クラスを作成する必要があります。
どの 2 つのアクションを実行する必要がありますか?それぞれの正解は完全な解決策を示します。
注: 正しく選択するたびに 1 ポイントの価値があります。

options.text_en: Declare the class and all its methods as public.
options.text_ja: クラスとそのすべてのメソッドをパブリックとして宣言します。

options.text_en: Implement only some methods in the classes that implement the interface.
options.text_ja: インターフェースを実装するクラスには一部のメソッドのみを実装します。
クラスを抽象として実装します。

options.text_en: Declare all methods in the classes that implement the interface.
options.text_ja: インターフェースを実装するクラス内のすべてのメソッドを宣言します。

C. This is incorrect because an interface in X++ is defined using the interface keyword, not as an abstract class. While abstract classes can also define
methods that must be implemented, they are distinct from interfaces. An interface cannot have any implementation, whereas an abstract class may
include both implemented and abstract methods.

question_en:
DRAG DROP -
Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm produces and sells jarred food goods. The organization has several production and warehouse locations
across the United States. Each location runs both production and warehousing operations. The company has three locations: East, Central, and
West.
The company is upgrading its Dynamics AX 2009 system to Dynamics 365 Finance.
Current environment. General -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to migrate customizations, data, and integration from its legacy system into Dynamics 365 finance
and operations apps.
The Dynamics 365 finance and operations environment includes:
• multiple cloud-hosted development environments using Microsoft Visual Studio 2017
• a Microsoft Azure DevOps project for source control
• two tier 2 environments for user acceptance testing and staging, as well as production
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the planning and development phase of the upgrade process. The company's internal
development team needs additional development resources to address issues. The company already created a project that is set up to use a
custom model named GPExtensions.
Current environment. Integrations
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has a new integration for its freight processing information. The internal development team created the
secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) site for the source information to be stored and the staging table to house the source information once the
data is added to Dynamics 365 Finance. Information from the source will be transferred once a day from the source system and integrated with
the target system. More than 10,000 records will be transferred over the integration. The company created an aggregate entity for the integration
to minimize the amount of transmitted data.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has added a new integration for freight processing where all item weights, dimensions, and other factors
will be configured in the external portal while planning the loads. Once the load is planned, it will be integrated into Dynamics 365 finance and
operations apps for the freight invoice processing to occur.
No duplicate invoices or posting are associated with the freight invoice charges. The integration of this information from the source system is
intended only for report creation and compilation purposes.
Current environment. Planned changes
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change inventory forms to fit its current needs. Any modifications or enhancements must follow
the existing functionality for forms in Dynamics 365 Finance.
Requirements. Integrations -
All data from integrations have the same format as an existing Dynamics 365 Finance apps field. All enhancements or customizations must use
existing assets before creating new functionality.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change its integration strategy to include real-time data from the freight processing source
system. The inventory must update as it is sold from the system. That information will be updated in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The freight processing integration requires the use of an SFTP site to store XML files from the source system. The additional integration will use
OData and must be transferred in real time.
A periodic batch job must:
• Pull data from the SFTP site.
• Import the data to a staging table used to hold the information from the source system.
• Map source data to the target table in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The imported Load ID field must be added to the Sales Order header for all processed orders. Additional requirements for integrations, including
other integration strategies, may be necessary as the company grows. Existing tables must be changed to include the Load ID. The database will
need to be synched before adding the Load ID field.
Requirements. Changes -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm must change the Inventory Status form to include more columns. It plans to create a table to enter the data
for the Inventory Status form as a new data source. The company wants to add both the Product Name field and Batch ID field to this new table.
The current form includes the item number, location, license plate, product inventory dimensions, and quantity.
The grid on the Inventory Status form must include the product name by using the item number and legal entity. The user interface must be
created to include the new columns and the data must be available to add to the grid. The form must have only an Action Pane, a Navigation List,
a List Style Grid, a Details Header, and a Details Tab in the design and include the Load ID field.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the process of adding the other required fields: one for Product Name and one for Batch ID.
The new fields must be related to extended data types for the original fields on the existing data source for the Inventory Status form. Munson's
Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to add the EcoResProductName and Batch ID data to the extended table for WHSTmpStatusChange. The fields
on the table extension must be populated with data and visible on the Inventory Status form on insert.
Issues -
• The internal development team has created the SFTP site connections, the staging table, and the batch jobs for the new integration for freight
processing. The development team needs to map the source data to the target table and the data management workspace. The development team
notices errors with mapping target fields in the data management workspace. The team needs another developer to configure the table
extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
• The internal development team has issues adding the required fields to the Inventory Status standard form. The team needs another developer to
configure the table extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
You need to create an extension of the table and perform a build and synchronize the newly extended table.
Which three actions should you perform in sequence? To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and
arrange them in the correct order.

試験の次のセクション。新しいセクションを開始した後は、このセクションに戻ることはできません。

発言。質問に答える準備ができたら、「質問」ボタンをクリックして質問に戻ります。

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、瓶詰め食品を製造および販売しています。組織には複数の生産拠点と倉庫拠点があります
アメリカ全土で。各拠点では生産と倉庫の両方の業務を行っています。同社には東、中央、東の 3 つの拠点があります。
西。
同社は、Dynamics AX 2009 システムを Dynamics 365 Finance にアップグレードしています。
現在の環境。一般 -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、カスタマイズ、データ、統合を従来のシステムから Dynamics 365 Finance に移行することを計画しています
および操作アプリ。
Dynamics 365 の財務および運用環境には次のものが含まれます。
• Microsoft Visual Studio 2017を使用した複数のクラウドホスト型開発環境
• ソース管理用の Microsoft Azure DevOps プロジェクト
• ユーザー受け入れテストとステージング、および運用用の 2 つの Tier 2 環境
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は現在、アップグレード プロセスの計画と開発段階にあります。会社の内部
開発チームは問題に対処するために追加の開発リソースを必要としています。会社はすでに、
GPExtensions という名前のカスタム モデル。
現在の環境。統合
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm では、貨物処理情報が新たに統合されました。社内開発チームが作成した
ソース情報を保存するためのセキュア ファイル転送プロトコル (SFTP) サイトと、ソース情報が保存された後にソース情報を格納するステージング テーブル
データが Dynamics 365 Finance に追加されます。ソースからの情報は、ソース システムから 1 日に 1 回転送され、
ターゲットシステム。この統合により、10,000 件を超えるレコードが転送されます。同社は統合のために集合体を作成した
送信されるデータ量を最小限に抑えます。
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、すべての商品の重量、寸法、その他の要素を考慮した貨物処理のための新しい統合を追加しました。
負荷の計画中に外部ポータルで構成されます。負荷が計画されると、Dynamics 365 Finance に統合され、
貨物請求書処理を実行するための運用アプリ。
運送請求書料金に関連付けられた重複した請求書や転記はありません。ソース システムからのこの情報の統合は、
レポートの作成と編集のみを目的としています。
現在の環境。計画された変更
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、現在のニーズに合わせて在庫形式を変更したいと考えています。変更や機能拡張は次のとおり行う必要があります
Dynamics 365 Finance のフォームの既存の機能。
要件。統合 -
統合からのすべてのデータは、既存の Dynamics 365 Finance アプリ フィールドと同じ形式です。すべての機能拡張またはカスタマイズでは、次のものを使用する必要があります
新しい機能を作成する前に既存の資産を再構築します。
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、統合戦略を変更して、貨物処理ソースからのリアルタイム データを含めたいと考えています。
システム。システムから販売されると在庫を更新する必要があります。その情報は Dynamics 365 Finance で更新されます。
貨物処理の統合では、SFTP サイトを使用してソース システムから XML ファイルを保存する必要があります。追加の統合では使用します
OData はリアルタイムで転送される必要があります。
定期的なバッチ ジョブは次のことを行う必要があります。
• SFTP サイトからデータを取得します。
• ソース システムからの情報を保持するために使用されるステージング テーブルにデータをインポートします。
• ソース データを Dynamics 365 Finance のターゲット テーブルにマップします。
インポートされたロード ID フィールドは、処理されたすべての注文の販売注文ヘッダーに追加する必要があります。統合のための追加要件:
会社が成長するにつれて、他の統合戦略が必要になる場合があります。ロード ID を含めるように既存のテーブルを変更する必要があります。データベースは、
ロード ID フィールドを追加する前に同期する必要があります。
要件。変更点 -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、より多くの列を含めるように在庫ステータス フォームを変更する必要があります。データを入力するテーブルを作成する予定です
新しいデータ ソースとしての在庫ステータス フォーム用。会社は、この新しいテーブルに製品名フィールドとバッチ ID フィールドの両方を追加したいと考えています。
現在のフォームには、品目番号、場所、ナンバー プレート、製品在庫の寸法、および数量が含まれています。
在庫状況フォームのグリッドには、品目番号と法人を使用して製品名を含める必要があります。ユーザーインターフェイスは次のようにする必要があります。
新しい列を含めるように作成され、データをグリッドに追加できるようにする必要があります。フォームにはアクション ウィンドウ、ナビゲーション リスト、
デザインにはリスト スタイル グリッド、詳細ヘッダー、および詳細タブが含まれ、ロード ID フィールドが含まれます。
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm では現在、他の必須フィールド (製品名用とバッチ ID 用) を追加中です。
新しいフィールドは、在庫ステータス フォームの既存のデータ ソース上の元のフィールドの拡張データ型に関連している必要があります。マンソンの
Pickles and Preserves Farm は、EcoResProductName とバッチ ID データを WHSTmpStatusChange の拡張テーブルに追加する予定です。畑
テーブル拡張機能にはデータが入力され、挿入時に在庫ステータス フォームに表示される必要があります。
問題点 -
• 内部開発チームは、SFTP サイト接続、ステージング テーブル、および貨物輸送の新しい統合用のバッチ ジョブを作成しました。
処理中。開発チームは、ソース データをターゲット テーブルおよびデータ管理ワークスペースにマップする必要があります。開発チーム
データ管理ワークスペース内のターゲット フィールドのマッピングに関するエラーを通知します。チームにはテーブルを構成するために別の開発者が必要です
計画された変更に必要な拡張機能、クラス拡張機能、およびフォーム拡張機能。
• 内部開発チームは、在庫ステータス標準フォームに必須フィールドを追加する際に問題を抱えています。チームには別の開発者が必要です
計画された変更に必要なテーブル拡張機能、クラス拡張機能、およびフォーム拡張機能を構成します。
テーブルの拡張を作成し、ビルドを実行して、新しく拡張されたテーブルを同期する必要があります。

それらを正しい順序で並べてください。

title: Topic 3 Question #81
question_en:
Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
ADatum Corporation is a market leader in the design and distribution of innovative aluminum systems. The company provides services to the
architectural, residential, industrial, and home improvement markets in Australia.
The company has warehouses in Perth. Sydney, and Melbourne. A team of warehouse employees provides delivery to the customer sites.
Current Environment -
ADatum Corporation currently uses Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009.
Customers use email or phone calls to place orders. After the company provides a quote to customers, the customer must agree to the sale price
before the company places a sales order.
The company is migrating to Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management using a phased rollout strategy to its sites. The
company has the Lifecycle services project to manage various environments and releases.
The company has the following Finance and Supply Chain Management environments:
• Development
• Quality assurance (QA)
• User acceptance testing (UAT)
• Production
The company uses Azure DevOps for a code repository. All developers use a development branch to check in code and a release branch to
maintain the code for production releases.
Requirements. General -
• Configure a cloud-based development environment for Finance and Supply Chain Management. Enable a code extension that supports updates.
• Configure Microsoft-supported version control and an Azure-hosted build pipeline.
• Migrate all document handling attachments for the customers to Finance and Supply Chain Management from Dynamics AX 2009.
• Audit X++ code for a best practice check.
• All new code must be unit tested in a development environment and then validated by the QA team before the code is merged into the Release
branch for further releases.
Requirements. Business processes
• All changes that are deployed to the UAT environment must be approved for code release to production.
• The sales manager requires a solution that is extensible to ensure that new master tables document handling attachments are migrated to the
new system.
• A base class named MigrateAttachment must be designed with methods that all child classes must implement.
• A method named processAttachment must be created so that extenders are not able to subscribe to pre-events and post-events.
• On the All sales orders list page, two new fields must be added for the total sales order amount. One field uses goods and services tax (GST) and
the other field does not use GST.
• A process named Populate check data must be designed based on the following: o The process must run from the All customers list page and
populate a custom table named CustCheckData with 1000 rows. o The table must have two fields named CheckNumber and BankNumber. o The
process must return to the current session after the data is processed.
• The generated check data must be available for users to access in a tabular form without additional details and preview panes.
• The purchase manager requires a new data entity to send out the information for purchase order inquiries that are generated in Finance and
Supply Chain Management
• The sales manager must be able to access the total quotation for the sites and item types.
• The sales manager requires a quotation number to be printed on the sales invoice business document. Customers must be able to access the
reference number on the invoice documents.
• The purchase manager requires a new approval workflow for approving purchase orders that are more than $10,000.
Requirements. Business systems -
• After a user named UserA posts a packing slip for a sales order, customers must be informed of the product delivery in real-time. This
information is provided using business events.
• Purchase order inquiries must be exported from the Finance and Supply Chain Management using data packages. Users must be able to query
using OData but should not be able to update or create the data in the system.
• A sales manager’s workspace must display the total quotations using key performance indicators.
• The purchase order approval workflow must be configured from the procurement and sourcing module.
Issues -
• UserA reports delays when opening the All sales orders list page.
• A customer is unable to access the business events for a packing slip that is posted by UserA.
• A user named UserB reports that the system is unresponsive when they run the Populate check data process for a customer.
• UserA reports that the print management settings in the accounts receivable module do not display the new layout when testing a new sales
invoice report layout in the UAT environment.
You need to design the processAttachment method for the MigrateAttachment class.
Which attribute should you use?
question_ja:
ケーススタディ -
これはケーススタディです。ケーススタディは個別に時間が設定されるわけではありません。各ケースを完了したいだけ試験時間を費やすことができます。ただし、
この試験には追加のケーススタディやセクションがある場合があります。すべての質問に確実に回答できるように時間を管理する必要があります
指定された時間内でこの試験に含まれています。
ケーススタディに含まれる質問に答えるには、ケーススタディで提供される情報を参照する必要があります。ケーススタディでは、
ケーススタディで説明されているシナリオに関する詳細情報を提供する展示やその他のリソースが含まれています。それぞれの質問は、
このケーススタディの他の質問とは独立しています。
このケーススタディの最後に、レビュー画面が表示されます。この画面では、回答を確認し、次のステップに進む前に変更を加えることができます。
試験の次のセクション。新しいセクションを開始した後は、このセクションに戻ることはできません。
ケーススタディを開始するには -
このケーススタディの最初の質問を表示するには、「次へ」ボタンをクリックします。左側のペインのボタンを使用して、ケーススタディの内容を調べます。
質問に答える前に。これらのボタンをクリックすると、ビジネス要件、既存の環境、問題などの情報が表示されます。
発言。質問に答える準備ができたら、「質問」ボタンをクリックして質問に戻ります。
背景 -
ADatum Corporation は、革新的なアルミニウム システムの設計と販売における市場リーダーです。同社は次のようなサービスを提供しています。
オーストラリアの建築、住宅、工業、住宅改善市場。
その会社はパースに倉庫を持っています。シドニーとメルボルン。倉庫従業員のチームが顧客サイトへの配送を行います。
現在の環境 -
ADatum Corporation は現在、Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009 を使用しています。
顧客は電子メールまたは電話を使用して注文します。当社が顧客に見積もりを提示した後、顧客は販売価格に同意する必要があります
会社が販売注文を出す前に。
同社は、サイトへの段階的なロールアウト戦略を使用して、Dynamics 365 Finance と Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management に移行しています。の
同社には、さまざまな環境とリリースを管理するためのライフサイクル サービス プロジェクトがあります。
同社には次の財務およびサプライ チェーン管理環境があります。
• 開発
• 品質保証 (QA)
• ユーザー受け入れテスト (UAT)
• 生産
同社はコード リポジトリに Azure DevOps を使用しています。すべての開発者は開発ブランチを使用してコードをチェックインし、リリース ブランチを使用してコードをチェックインします。
実稼働リリース用のコードを保守します。
要件。一般 -

question_en:
Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case. However,
there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions
included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case study. Case studies might
contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is described in the case study. Each question is
independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to
the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this section.
To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm produces and sells jarred food goods. The organization has several production and warehouse locations
across the United States. Each location runs both production and warehousing operations. The company has three locations: East, Central, and
West.
The company is upgrading its Dynamics AX 2009 system to Dynamics 365 Finance.
Current environment. General -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to migrate customizations, data, and integration from its legacy system into Dynamics 365 finance
and operations apps.
The Dynamics 365 finance and operations environment includes:
• multiple cloud-hosted development environments using Microsoft Visual Studio 2017
• a Microsoft Azure DevOps project for source control
• two tier 2 environments for user acceptance testing and staging, as well as production
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the planning and development phase of the upgrade process. The company's internal
development team needs additional development resources to address issues. The company already created a project that is set up to use a
custom model named GPExtensions.
Current environment. Integrations
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has a new integration for its freight processing information. The internal development team created the
secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) site for the source information to be stored and the staging table to house the source information once the
data is added to Dynamics 365 Finance. Information from the source will be transferred once a day from the source system and integrated with
the target system. More than 10,000 records will be transferred over the integration. The company created an aggregate entity for the integration
to minimize the amount of transmitted data.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm has added a new integration for freight processing where all item weights, dimensions, and other factors
will be configured in the external portal while planning the loads. Once the load is planned, it will be integrated into Dynamics 365 finance and
operations apps for the freight invoice processing to occur.
No duplicate invoices or posting are associated with the freight invoice charges. The integration of this information from the source system is
intended only for report creation and compilation purposes.
Current environment. Planned changes
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change inventory forms to fit its current needs. Any modifications or enhancements must follow
the existing functionality for forms in Dynamics 365 Finance.
Requirements. Integrations -
All data from integrations have the same format as an existing Dynamics 365 Finance apps field. All enhancements or customizations must use
existing assets before creating new functionality.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm wants to change its integration strategy to include real-time data from the freight processing source
system. The inventory must update as it is sold from the system. That information will be updated in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The freight processing integration requires the use of an SFTP site to store XML files from the source system. The additional integration will use
OData and must be transferred in real time.
A periodic batch job must:
• Pull data from the SFTP site.
• Import the data to a staging table used to hold the information from the source system.
• Map source data to the target table in Dynamics 365 Finance.
The imported Load ID field must be added to the Sales Order header for all processed orders. Additional requirements for integrations, including
other integration strategies, may be necessary as the company grows. Existing tables must be changed to include the Load ID. The database will
need to be synched before adding the Load ID field.
Requirements. Changes -
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm must change the Inventory Status form to include more columns. It plans to create a table to enter the data
for the Inventory Status form as a new data source. The company wants to add both the Product Name field and Batch ID field to this new table.
The current form includes the item number, location, license plate, product inventory dimensions, and quantity.
The grid on the Inventory Status form must include the product name by using the item number and legal entity. The user interface must be
created to include the new columns and the data must be available to add to the grid. The form must have only an Action Pane, a Navigation List,
a List Style Grid, a Details Header, and a Details Tab in the design and include the Load ID field.
Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm is currently in the process of adding the other required fields: one for Product Name and one for Batch ID.
The new fields must be related to extended data types for the original fields on the existing data source for the Inventory Status form. Munson's
Pickles and Preserves Farm plans to add the EcoResProductName and Batch ID data to the extended table for WHSTmpStatusChange. The fields
on the table extension must be populated with data and visible on the Inventory Status form on insert.
Issues -
• The internal development team has created the SFTP site connections, the staging table, and the batch jobs for the new integration for freight
processing. The development team needs to map the source data to the target table and the data management workspace. The development team
notices errors with mapping target fields in the data management workspace. The team needs another developer to configure the table
extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
• The internal development team has issues adding the required fields to the Inventory Status standard form. The team needs another developer to
configure the table extensions, class extensions, and form extensions that are required for the planned changes.
You need to add data to the WHSTmpStatusChange table by extending the insert method.
What should you do?

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm では、貨物処理情報が新たに統合されました。社内開発チームが作成した

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、すべての商品の重量、寸法、その他の要素を考慮した貨物処理のための新しい統合を追加しました。
負荷の計画中に外部ポータルで構成されます。負荷が計画されると、Dynamics 365 Finance に統合され、
貨物請求書処理を実行するための運用アプリ。
運送請求書料金に関連付けられた重複した請求書や転記はありません。ソース システムからのこの情報の統合は、

Munson's Pickles and Preserves Farm は、現在のニーズに合わせて在庫形式を変更したいと考えています。変更や機能拡張は次のとおり行う必要があります

they didnt write tmpFrmVirtual.update(); that's why answer is correct

The updateValues function creates a local variable for the table that is a reference to the parameter (not a copy)...any changes made to the local
variable are reflected on the original buffer. The run method does not attempt to re-read from the tmpFrmVirtual buffer after calling updateValues,
so calling 'update' on the buffer does not matter for this example.

Disregarding the fact that the given code wouldn't even compile...
The output would be :
1) TmpFrmVirtual.Id ==> SID1234-Updated
2) salesQty ==> 5
As stated earlier by others :
-------------------------------------------
1)
TmpFrmVirtual is a table buffer, and is always passed as a reference (i.e. as a pointer to the original table buffer, NOT as a COPY of the original table
buffer). So any changes to the buffer made in the updateValues() method are actually made to the original buffer in the run() method.
2)
The salesQty variable, on the other hand, is converted to and passed as a String, then converted back to integer. This means that we're are actually
modifying the value of a COPY of the original variable, NOT the value of the original variable itself. Also the COPY of the original value only exists
while executing the updateValues() method and it's value is never returned to the run() method. Hence the value of the salesQty variable in the run()
method remaines unchanged.

ai_verdict.analysis_en:
Box 1: Yes -
Class extension - Method wrapping and Chain of Command.
The functionality for class extension, or class augmentation, has been improved. You can now wrap logic around methods that are defined in
the base class that you're augmenting. You can extend the logic of public and protected methods without having to use event handlers. When
you wrap a method, you can also access public and protected methods, and variables of the base class. In this way, you can start transactions
and easily manage state variables that are associated with your class.
Box 2: Yes -
In the following example, the wrapper around doSomething and the required use of the next keyword create a Chain of Command (CoC) for the
method. CoC is a design pattern where a request is handled by a series of receivers. The pattern supports loose coupling of the sender and the
receivers
[ExtensionOf(classStr(BusinessLogic1))]
final class BusinessLogic1_Extension
{
str doSomething(int arg)
{
// Part 1
var s = next doSomething(arg + 4);
// Part 2
return s;
}
}
Box 3: Yes -
Instance and static methods can be wrapped by extension classes. If a static method is the target that will be wrapped, the method in the
extension must be qualified by using the static keyword.
Box 4: No -
Wrapper methods must always call next.
Note: Wrapper methods in an extension class must always call next, so that the next method in the chain and, finally, the original
implementation are always called. This restriction helps guarantee that every method in the chain contributes to the result.
In the current implementation of this restriction, the call to next must be in the first-level statements in the method body.
Here are some important rules:
✑ Calls to next can't be done conditionally inside an if statement.
✑ Calls to next can't be done in while, do-while, or for loop statements.
✑ A next statement can't be preceded by a return statement.
✑ Because logical expressions are optimized, calls to next can't occur in logical expressions. At runtime, the execution of the complete
expression isn't guaranteed.
Reference:
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/extensibility/method-wrapping-coc

The answer of the question is correct
Yes,Yes,Yes and No

The given answer is correct. The 4th requirement - No. The reason is given below:
--> An extension class is essentially a static augmentation of the base class. It does not exist as a standalone class that you can instantiate directly.
Instead, it extends the behavior of the base class, and its methods are "merged" into the base class at runtime.
--> You cannot create an instance of the extension class itself in X++ when using the ExtensionOf attribute. Instead, instantiate the base class, and
the system will incorporate the extension’s methods (both CoC-wrapped methods and new methods) automatically. This is by design to maintain the
extensibility model

comments.text:
Commands allow for two types of fluent setter methods, for methods and set methods:
=> for – These methods are used for command parameters that represent the entities that the command applies to. For example, the invoice
command can apply to sales orders. Therefore, a for method is used to set the sales order that the invoice command applies to.
=> set – These methods are used for all other parameters of the command. For example, when you reserve a sales line, you usually specify a
quantity. The quantity isn't something that the command applies to but is instead a simple parameter of the command. Therefore, a set method is
used to specify the quantity parameter of the reservation command.

Answer appears to be correct. Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/perf-test/concepts-
commands#fluent-setter-methods

あなたは Dynamics 365 Finance 開発者です。

vehicle 変数の VehicleId フィールドに基づいて、FMVehicle テーブルからすべてのレコードを昇順で選択する必要があります。

You are performing a review of the code that returns the total sum of transactions for all customers in customer group 10. You observe that the
following query takes a long time to complete.
You need to modify the query to optimize performance.
Which code segment should you use?
question_ja:
ある企業は Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management を使用しています。
あなたは、顧客グループ 10 のすべての顧客のトランザクションの合計を返すコードのレビューを実行しています。
次のクエリは完了するまでに長い時間がかかります。
パフォーマンスを最適化するにはクエリを変更する必要があります。
どのコードセグメントを使用する必要がありますか?

options.text_en: Select sum(AmountMst) from custTrans join custId, custGroup from custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10';
options.text_ja: custTrans join custId から sum(AmountMst) を選択し、custTable から custGroup を選択します (custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup ==) '10';

options.text_en: AmountMST sumTrans = 0; while select AmountMst from custTrans join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10' { sumTrans = sumTrans + custTrans.AmountMst; }
options.text_ja: AmountMST sumTrans = 0; while select AmountMst from custTrans join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10' { sumTrans = sumTrans + custTrans.AmountMst;

options.text_en: select sum(AmountMst) from custTrans join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10';
options.text_ja: select sum(AmountMst) from custTrans join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10';

options.text_en: select sum(AmountMst) from custTrans exists join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10';
options.text_ja: custTrans から sum(AmountMst) を選択 存在します join custTable where custTable.AccountNum == custTrans.AccountNum && custTable.custGroup == '10';

At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make changes before you move to

To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the content of the case study
before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business requirements, existing environment, and problem
statements. When you are ready to answer a question, click the Question button to return to the question.
Background -
ADatum Corporation is a market leader in the design and distribution of innovative aluminum systems. The company provides services to the
architectural, residential, industrial, and home improvement markets in Australia.
The company has warehouses in Perth. Sydney, and Melbourne. A team of warehouse employees provides delivery to the customer sites.
Current Environment -
ADatum Corporation currently uses Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009.
Customers use email or phone calls to place orders. After the company provides a quote to customers, the customer must agree to the sale price
before the company places a sales order.
The company is migrating to Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management using a phased rollout strategy to its sites. The
company has the Lifecycle services project to manage various environments and releases.
The company has the following Finance and Supply Chain Management environments:
• Development
• Quality assurance (QA)
• User acceptance testing (UAT)
• Production
The company uses Azure DevOps for a code repository. All developers use a development branch to check in code and a release branch to
maintain the code for production releases.
Requirements. General -
• Configure a cloud-based development environment for Finance and Supply Chain Management. Enable a code extension that supports updates.
• Configure Microsoft-supported version control and an Azure-hosted build pipeline.
• Migrate all document handling attachments for the customers to Finance and Supply Chain Management from Dynamics AX 2009.
• Audit X++ code for a best practice check.
• All new code must be unit tested in a development environment and then validated by the QA team before the code is merged into the Release
branch for further releases.
Requirements. Business processes
• All changes that are deployed to the UAT environment must be approved for code release to production.
• The sales manager requires a solution that is extensible to ensure that new master tables document handling attachments are migrated to the
new system.
• A base class named MigrateAttachment must be designed with methods that all child classes must implement.
• A method named processAttachment must be created so that extenders are not able to subscribe to pre-events and post-events.
• On the All sales orders list page, two new fields must be added for the total sales order amount. One field uses goods and services tax (GST) and
the other field does not use GST.
• A process named Populate check data must be designed based on the following: o The process must run from the All customers list page and
populate a custom table named CustCheckData with 1000 rows. o The table must have two fields named CheckNumber and BankNumber. o The
process must return to the current session after the data is processed.
• The generated check data must be available for users to access in a tabular form without additional details and preview panes.
• The purchase manager requires a new data entity to send out the information for purchase order inquiries that are generated in Finance and
Supply Chain Management
• The sales manager must be able to access the total quotation for the sites and item types.
• The sales manager requires a quotation number to be printed on the sales invoice business document. Customers must be able to access the
reference number on the invoice documents.
• The purchase manager requires a new approval workflow for approving purchase orders that are more than $10,000.
Requirements. Business systems -
• After a user named UserA posts a packing slip for a sales order, customers must be informed of the product delivery in real-time. This
information is provided using business events.
• Purchase order inquiries must be exported from the Finance and Supply Chain Management using data packages. Users must be able to query
using OData but should not be able to update or create the data in the system.
• A sales manager’s workspace must display the total quotations using key performance indicators.
• The purchase order approval workflow must be configured from the procurement and sourcing module.
Issues -
• UserA reports delays when opening the All sales orders list page.
• A customer is unable to access the business events for a packing slip that is posted by UserA.
• A user named UserB reports that the system is unresponsive when they run the Populate check data process for a customer.
• UserA reports that the print management settings in the accounts receivable module do not display the new layout when testing a new sales
invoice report layout in the UAT environment.
You need to resolve the issue for UserB.
Which framework should you use?
question_ja:

この試験には追加のケーススタディやセクションがある場合があります。すべての質問に確実に回答できるように時間を管理する必要があります
指定された時間内でこの試験に含まれています。
ケーススタディに含まれる質問に答えるには、ケーススタディで提供される情報を参照する必要があります。ケーススタディでは、
ケーススタディで説明されているシナリオに関する詳細情報を提供する展示やその他のリソースが含まれています。それぞれの質問は、
このケーススタディの他の質問とは独立しています。
このケーススタディの最後に、レビュー画面が表示されます。この画面では、回答を確認し、次のステップに進む前に変更を加えることができます。
試験の次のセクション。新しいセクションを開始した後は、このセクションに戻ることはできません。
